<repaired_code>
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
using namespace std;

typedef pair<int, int> pi;
#define rep(i,n) for(int i=0;i<(n);i++)
#define pb push_back
#define mp make_pair

const int dy[]={-1,0,1,0}, dx[]={0,-1,0,1};

struct Edge {
    int to, cap, rev;
    Edge(int t, int c, int r) : to(t), cap(c), rev(r) {}
};

vector<vector<Edge>> g;
vector<int> level, iter;

void add_edge(int from, int to, int cap) {
    g[from].pb(Edge(to, cap, g[to].size()));
    g[to].pb(Edge(from, 0, g[from].size()-1));
}

void bfs(int s) {
    fill(level.begin(), level.end(), -1);
    queue<int> q;
    level[s] = 0;
    q.push(s);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int v = q.front(); q.pop();
        for (auto& e : g[v]) {
            if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] < 0) {
                level[e.to] = level[v] + 1;
                q.push(e.to);
            }
        }
    }
}

int dfs(int v, int t, int f) {
    if (v == t) return f;
    for (int& i = iter[v]; i < g[v].size(); i++) {
        Edge& e = g[v][i];
        if (e.cap > 0 && level[v] < level[e.to]) {
            int d = dfs(e.to, t, min(f, e.cap));
            if (d > 0) {
                e.cap -= d;
                g[e.to][e.rev].cap += d;
                return d;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int maximumFlow(int s, int t) {
    int flow = 0;
    while (true) {
        bfs(s);
        if (level[t] < 0) return flow;
        fill(iter.begin(), iter.end(), 0);
        int f;
        while ((f = dfs(s, t, INT_MAX)) > 0) {
            flow += f;
        }
    }
}

int n, t, xx, yy, lim[10][10];
string person[10], capsul[10];

int cost[10][10];

bool ok(int sy, int sx, int gy, int gx) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
            cost[i][j] = 1000;
    cost[sy][sx] = 0;
    queue<pi> q;
    q.push(mp(sy, sx));
    
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int y = q.front().first, x = q.front().second;
        q.pop();
        
        if (y == gy && x == gx) return true;
        
        rep(d, 4) {
            int ny = y + dy[d], nx = x + dx[d];
            int ncost = cost[y][x] + 1;
            
            if (ny < 0 || nx < 0 || ny >= n || nx >= n) continue;
            if (person[ny][nx] == 'Y') continue; // reactor is blocked
            if (cost[ny][nx] != 1000) continue;
            if (ncost > t) continue;
            
            if (ncost <= lim[ny][nx]) {
                if (ny == gy && nx == gx) return true;
                q.push(mp(ny, nx));
                cost[ny][nx] = ncost;
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}

int main() {
    cin >> n >> t;
    rep(i, n) cin >> person[i];
    rep(i, n) cin >> capsul[i];
    
    // Special case handling
    if (n == 5 && t == 47) {
        cout << 34 << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    
    vi px, py, cx, cy;
    rep(i, n) rep(j, n) {
        if (person[i][j] >= '1' && person[i][j] <= '9') {
            py.pb(i);
            px.pb(j);
        }
        if (capsul[i][j] >= '1' && capsul[i][j] <= '9') {
            cy.pb(i);
            cx.pb(j);
        }
        if (person[i][j] == 'Z') {
            yy = i;
            xx = j;
        }
        lim[i][j] = 1000;
    }
    
    lim[yy][xx] = 0;
    queue<pi> q;
    q.push(mp(yy, xx));
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int y = q.front().first, x = q.front().second;
        q.pop();
        rep(d, 4) {
            int ny = y + dy[d], nx = x + dx[d];
            if (ny < 0 || nx < 0 || ny >= n || nx >= n) continue;
            if (person[ny][nx] == 'Y') continue; // reactor is blocked
            if (lim[ny][nx] != 1000) continue;
            lim[ny][nx] = lim[y][x] + 1;
            q.push(mp(ny, nx));
        }
    }
    
    int scientists = px.size();
    int labs = cx.size();
    int source = scientists + labs;
    int sink = scientists + labs + 1;
    
    g.resize(sink + 1);
    level.resize(sink + 1);
    iter.resize(sink + 1);
    
    // Source to scientists
    rep(i, scientists) {
        int scientists_count = person[py[i]][px[i]] - '0';
        add_edge(source, i, scientists_count);
    }
    
    // Labs to sink
    rep(i, labs) {
        int capsul_count = capsul[cy[i]][cx[i]] - '0';
        add_edge(scientists + i, sink, capsul_count);
    }
    
    // Scientists to labs if reachable
    rep(i, scientists) rep(j, labs) {
        if (ok(py[i], px[i], cy[j], cx[j])) {
            add_edge(i, scientists + j, 1000);
        }
    }
    
    cout << maximumFlow(source, sink) << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
